note: OBTRAN 001's films (Paul, 25 October: "videos look good, let's wire them in"): photoreal, in colour (colour), through the Super 8 pass, with a DNA decode readout instead of Bob's CCTV (readout). Seedance 2.5 renders from the live-action stills (comics/obtran001/films/shots.json), 9:16, 5 s. Each comes up over its caption's space with the caption over it (card). See prototype/assets/films/index.json for every option.

o1-cockpit.note: the cryptid at the controls, light pulsing through his veins, his eyes turning orange; 16:9 full screen (Paul: "re-render cryptid at controls as 16:9 full screen"; approved). The push in ends on his face at the right, so portrait screens cut it at 0.62 across and the caption sits at the left. The 9:16 take (o1-cockpit.mp4) is kept as a spare

o1-shadows.note: the bonfire ritual in 16:9, the camera orbiting the tent looking in at the fire, the dancers and their shadows (Paul: approved); the 9:16 take (o1-shadows.mp4) is a spare

o1-eye.note: the cryptid's eye: the lid trembles, it snaps open in the first second and holds, the fire and dancers reflected

o1-escape.note: QNTM CNTRL escaping Lyra (Paul's film, 25 October: 4 s, 16:9, plays full screen once for its length): the ship fills the frame, its engines light and it pulls away; portrait screens cut it about the ship (focus), wide ones show it whole

jets.note: Paul, 26 October: the engines keep burning over the last frame while the film waits for the reader. Each flare in the last frame as [u, v, plume length, core radius] (shares of the frame's width), measured from it; the plumes run left

o1-eye-final.note: the finale eye (Paul's still 1, outpainted to 16:9): it fills the screen, the pupil moves; the helix grows out of it

o1-lyra-wide.note: extreme wide of Lyra in ruins, the tiny ship shooting off the planet to the upper right (Paul: before the close up of the ship); 16:9

o1-patrol.note: the scout patrol on their mounts at dusk watching the ship streak down across the sky (Paul: "render this scene as video"); 16:9

o1-crash.note: the wreck smoking in the dusk forest, the scouts on the ridge (Paul: the crash panel as live action; approved); 16:9

lifeform.note: ...a DNA-encrypted lifeform! The light runs through his veins as the caption names him

ritual.note: the bonfire ritual: the dancers' shadows (Paul: "definitely a video render"); the drum interaction follows the film once built

vessel.note: ...apart from the holosonic vessel QNTM CNTRL: instead of the illustrated scene, the wide shot of the ship leaving the ruined planet, then straight into the close up of it escaping with its sound, resting on its last frame until the line ends (Paul)

patrol.note: Our fallen ship is intercepted by a scout patrol: the scouts watch it fall, then the wreck smoking with the patrol on the ridge, resting on its last frame until the reader moves on (Paul)
